name: Ikazuchi Akira
source: Joins in the earth route. Master of the lighting type guardian Zabitan. Tokusatsu otaku and rock singer of justice. A tokusatsu maniac to the point where she can't help but act like a hero of justice and never fails to have a dramatic speech ready. Fights against Egubado to be just like the heroes she admires.
